project: AI Video Assistant - Permanent History & RAG Persistence

stories.title: SQLite persistence layer with SQLAlchemy
stories.description: Create SQLAlchemy database engine, session management, AnalysisHistory ORM model, automatic table initialization, and persistent storage in backend/data/history.db.

stories.title: FastAPI history endpoints and pipeline auto-save
stories.description: Add /api/v1/history POST, GET list (newest first), GET by id, and DELETE by id endpoints; auto-save successful /api/v1/pipeline results without saving failures.

stories.title: RAG persistence across FastAPI restarts
stories.description: Ensure ChromaDB path is consistent, detect existing session vectors in ChromaDB, and reconstruct RAG chains via load_rag_chain without unnecessary re-embedding when rag_sessions is empty after restart.

stories.title: Frontend API client and History page integration
stories.description: Add history functions to frontend/api_client.py, remove st.session_state.analysis_history as permanent store, fetch history from FastAPI on History page, display metadata + summary preview, and support Open Analysis and Delete.

stories.title: Automated tests for history CRUD, pipeline auto-save, and RAG restart persistence
stories.description: Add pytest tests using temporary SQLite DB and ChromaDB to verify CRUD, newest-first ordering, pipeline auto-save/no-save-on-error, and RAG query after simulated restart.

stories.title: Update README and verify FastAPI + Streamlit restart persistence
stories.description: Document database architecture, location, dependencies, and new endpoints in README.md, and verify FastAPI + Streamlit persistence across restarts.

stories.title: Create backend Dockerfile, .dockerignore, and fix requirements.txt
stories.description: Fix invalid/missing entries in backend/requirements.txt, create backend/.dockerignore and backend/Dockerfile using Python 3.11, ffmpeg, and Uvicorn on 0.0.0.0:${PORT:-8000}, and verify image build.

stories.title: Create frontend Dockerfile and .dockerignore
stories.description: Create frontend/.dockerignore and frontend/Dockerfile using Python 3.11, frontend/requirements.txt, and Streamlit on 0.0.0.0:8501, and verify image build.

stories.title: Create root docker-compose.yml with networking, healthchecks, and volumes
stories.description: Create docker-compose.yml defining backend and frontend services, shared network, healthcheck, depends_on, AI_VIDEO_API_URL=http://backend:8000/api/v1, env_file, and persistent volumes for downloads, data, and vector_db.

stories.title: Build, start, and verify full Docker Compose stack
stories.description: Run docker compose up -d --build, verify backend health and /docs, frontend on 8501, frontend-to-backend API communication, container logs, env vars, and persistent storage.
